[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Cancel labels — relation labels that cancel their source task[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Committing a relation whose label is listed in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`relations.cancel_labels` (starting with `duplicate of` and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`superseded by`, configured in chezmoi) cancels the relation's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]source task in the same gesture, exactly as Task Card Cancel would:[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`[-]` plus `\[cancelled:: today]`, its links removed from today's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]open Pomodoros, and blocked dependents recovered. Every surface [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]names the task before you commit (⊘ plus words, `↵ link & cancel`),[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and nothing else ever cancels or reopens because of a label.[/#D7D7AF]
